original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target literally with target-selection.json/full_target and the complete problem.md:16-41 statement; the selected target is preserved exactly, and spec.conclusion states both nonzeroness and the universally quantified invariant-subspace dichotomy. H001-H007 retain primality, characteristic, the full range, characteristic-zero irreducible highest-weight module with dimension, all three Chevalley commutators, the nonzero highest vector with both equations, and the arbitrary admissible lattice with its simultaneous integer/complex basis and all divided-power stability. All seven original H occur in the graph and are used; the characteristic-zero irreducibility/highest-weight description in H004 is retained although the proof needs only its dimension in addition to H005-H006. D001-D003 preserve X_r=x^r/r!, Y_r=y^r/r! and the generated unital integer algebra. D004-D006 preserve n and the candidate basis; defining the same e_i formula for all natural i is a harmless extension of notation, and all basis indices remain exactly 0..lambda. D007 uses H001 to define the genuine subring Z_(p). D008 is the abstract tensor module, and D009 is its multiplication map; injectivity is proved in R002/S002 rather than assumed by their types. D010 is guarded by N001, so no matrix unit precedes the proved complex basis. D011-D012 are preimages of an R-submodule under multiplication by e_i, hence legitimate R-submodules; J is defined by the zeroth coordinate and equality of all coordinates is proved in R003/S001. D013 is the original tensor V(K), D014 uses H005 for the Chevalley Lie lattice, and D015-D020 require N002 for lattice preservation before defining reduced actions; all use sites supply those guards directly. D021 uses H001-H002 for the prime field and its embedding. Thus none of the D types grants a desired basis, equality of J_i, injectivity, or principality. The two actual native theorem sources M001 and M002 were probed successfully in the pinned library and compared with Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/Constructions.lean:297-302 and :345-378. Their restatements preserve all semiring/module structures, strong rank conditions, freeness, finite-index/finite-generation premises where present, and the absence of a finite-generation premise in M002. Both actual applications are at R003/S003 with complete grounds. No literature theorem is imported as E: Humphreys section 27 exercise 7 is the supplied target's provenance, while the full Lie, lattice and reduction argument is proved here, so no missing primary theorem is being silently assumed or deferred. The graph has exactly one producer each for N001-N004 and P, with successive five-phase route R001 coordinates, R002 localized matrix units, R003 common rank-one principal coordinate module, R004 reduction/base change, R005 irreducibility. Every non-H node is in P's backward closure and there is no cycle or extra trusted internal root. No material part of the supplied proof was omitted; its projection named P was renamed locally Q solely to avoid collision with the target ID.
